entities.summary: The Cathedral of Saint John of Nepomuk is a Roman Catholic Cathedral in Zrenjanin, Serbia. It is the seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Zrenjanin that covers the territory of Serbian Banat. The Cathedral is located in the Zrenjanin's main square, Trg slobode. It is dedicated to Saint John of Nepomuk.
